name: Rocket Propulsion
shortDefinition: The mechanism of generating thrust by expelling high-velocity exhaust gases according to Newton’s third law of motion.

name: Thrust
shortDefinition: The forward propulsive force generated by an engine to overcome aerodynamic drag and gravitational pull.

name: Cryogenic Rocket Engine
shortDefinition: A rocket engine that uses liquefied gases stored at extremely low temperatures—typically liquid oxygen (-183°C) and liquid hydrogen (-253°C)—as oxidizer and fuel.

name: Semi-Cryogenic Rocket Engine
shortDefinition: A high-thrust rocket propulsion system that pairs a cryogenic oxidizer (liquid oxygen) with room-temperature refined hydrocarbon fuel (such as aviation-grade kerosene or Isrosene) for denser propellant storage and higher liftoff thrust.

name: Launch Vehicle
shortDefinition: A multi-stage rocket designed to transport satellites, spacecraft, or human crew from Earth’s surface into orbital trajectories or deep space.

name: Payload Capacity
shortDefinition: The maximum mass of cargo, satellites, or instruments a launch vehicle can deliver into a specific target orbit.

name: Repo Rate
shortDefinition: The benchmark interest rate at which a central bank lends short-term funds to commercial banks against government securities.

name: Monetary Policy
shortDefinition: The macroeconomic framework used by a central bank to manage money supply, credit availability, and interest rates to achieve sustainable economic growth and price stability.

name: Inflation Targeting
shortDefinition: A central banking framework where monetary policy is adjusted specifically to maintain the headline consumer inflation rate within an explicit target band (e.g., 4% ± 2%).

name: Fiscal Deficit
shortDefinition: The shortfall between a government’s total expenditure and its total revenue (excluding market borrowings), indicating total borrowing requirements.

name: Interest Rate
shortDefinition: The proportion of a loan that is charged as interest to the borrower, typically expressed as an annual percentage of the loan outstanding.

name: Large Language Model (LLM)
shortDefinition: A deep learning neural network trained on massive text corpora to understand, generate, and reason with human language across diverse tasks.

name: Transformer Architecture
shortDefinition: A neural network architecture that processes sequential data in parallel using self-attention mechanisms to weigh the relative importance of words across an entire context window.

name: Sovereign AI Infrastructure
shortDefinition: A nation’s independent capability to produce, train, deploy, and govern artificial intelligence infrastructure, compute hardware, foundational models, and datasets within its borders.

name: Agentic AI
shortDefinition: Autonomous software systems powered by AI models that can plan multi-step actions, use tools, and execute workflows without continuous human intervention.

name: Waterless Datacenter Cooling
shortDefinition: High-density hardware thermal management systems that dissipate extreme compute heat loads without consuming municipal water supplies or evaporative towers.

name: Supercomputing Grid
shortDefinition: An interconnected cluster of high-performance computing nodes designed to execute quadrillions of calculations per second for scientific modeling and AI workloads.

name: Semiconductor Fabrication Facility (Fab)
shortDefinition: A specialized industrial plant containing ultra-pure cleanrooms where integrated circuits and microchips are manufactured on silicon wafers.

name: Cleanroom
shortDefinition: An engineered manufacturing space with strictly controlled air filtration, humidity, and temperature to prevent microscopic airborne particles from contaminating silicon wafers.

name: ATMP / OSAT Packaging
shortDefinition: The downstream semiconductor process where fabricated silicon wafers are cut into individual dies, packaged in protective casings, and tested before deployment in electronics.

name: EV Fast-Charging Infrastructure
shortDefinition: High-voltage direct-current (DC) power delivery systems capable of recharging an electric vehicle battery to 80% capacity in under 45 minutes.

name: Electric Powertrain
shortDefinition: The assembly of electrical and mechanical components—including the electric motor, inverter, transmission, and controller—that converts stored battery energy into vehicle propulsion.

name: Global Capability Centre (GCC)
shortDefinition: An offshore strategic enterprise unit owned by a multinational corporation that performs high-value research, engineering, and core product development.

name: Unified Payments Interface (UPI)
shortDefinition: A real-time payment system developed by NPCI that facilitates inter-bank peer-to-peer and person-to-merchant digital transactions via mobile devices.

name: Initial Public Offering (IPO)
shortDefinition: The process by which a privately held company raises equity capital by offering shares to the public on an exchange for the first time.

name: Venture Capital & Growth Equity
shortDefinition: Private equity financing provided by investors to early-stage and growth startups with perceived high long-term growth potential.

name: IT Services & Digital Transformation
shortDefinition: The provision of custom software development, cloud migration, cybersecurity, and system integration services to global commercial enterprises.
